column1: # The HPS-to-FPGA bridge at the fabric: per port bit of the HPS atom, the routing-graph node it
# meets. in = fabric drives the HPS (the RPII sink); out = the HPS drives the fabric (the last
# SOC_HPS_WRAPPER_RE node of its route). SOC2FPGA_CLK is the bridge clock, a sink of a global
# clock. 32 of the atom's 40 address bits. From a Quartus 26.1.1 route dump (tools/hps_routes.tcl,
# HPS_ROUTES_MATCH='SOC2FPGA_*') of designs/hpsf built with HPSF_BRIDGEMAP (every bit live),
# tabled by tools/hps_table.py, which gives the 181 bits of lwhps2fpga.tsv the same build routes
# exactly as that table has them.
